name: Jolly Robin 0
author: Pradeepsaranbishnoi
description: Neon rounded red button that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks: Clicking it toggles it: text color changes from #000000 to #ff0000, filter becomes blur(0.5px), box-shadow becomes 0 10px 25px -4px #000000, inset 0 -8px 25px -1px #ffffff, 0 -10px 15px -1px #ffffff, inset 0 8px 20px 0 #000000, inset 0 0 5px 1px #ffffff.
